items.passage0: In Stardew Valley, my farmer fought monsters in the mine all day. He didn't eat any food, so his health went down to zero. He passed out and woke up in the clinic. The doctor, Harvey, said, "Please be more careful." Now I always bring food to the mine.
items.passage1: Last Monday, I had a sore throat and a fever, so I couldn't go to school. Mom took me to the doctor. The doctor said it was just a cold, not a serious illness. He gave me some medicine and told me to drink lots of warm water. After three days, I felt much better.
items.passage2: Kevin loves eating candy, but he doesn't like brushing his teeth. Last week, he had a terrible toothache. His dad took him to the dentist. The dentist found a hole in one tooth. Now Kevin brushes his teeth twice a day with his new blue toothbrush.
items.passage3: During P.E. class, Amy fell and hurt her ankle. It was very painful, and she couldn't walk. Our teacher called the school nurse. The nurse put some ice on Amy's ankle. After school, her dad took her to see a doctor. A week later, Amy could run again.
items.passage4: In our town game, Rosa is the town doctor. She always says, "Eat well, sleep well, and have fun." Every morning, she goes for a walk to keep her heart healthy. When a villager is ill, she visits them with some medicine. Everybody in town loves her.
